items.title: working on lob-alpha
items.body: Short-horizon price prediction from limit order book data

details.summary: Daniel started lob-alpha, a model that predicts the next few seconds of price movement from limit order book snapshots, then backtests a market-making strategy on those predictions.
highlights: Small LSTM over order book imbalance and bid-ask spread features
Walk-forward backtest that charges fees and slippage instead of assuming mid-price fills
Simulator core rewritten in C++ after the Python version got too slow
Latest commits add inventory limits so the market maker stops quoting when it holds too much
details.ask: How are you keeping the backtest from seeing future order book data?

items.title: working on clubhub and 1 more project
items.body: Sara is building ClubHub, a campus clubs app, and just shipped v1.1 with event reminders and dark mode.

details.summary: Sara is building ClubHub, a React Native app where Georgia Tech clubs post events and members RSVP, and just shipped v1.1 with event reminders and dark mode.
highlights: clubhub: live on the web; latest release adds push reminders one hour before an RSVP'd event
clubhub-ui: the open-source component kit behind ClubHub, driven by design tokens with accessible focus order
